recommended_episode.title: Megaboom: 20k routing congestion DRCs at 0.24 placement density
recommended_episode.prior_state: The reported BoomTile design failed global routing with 20k routing-congestion DRCs at placement density 0.24, with apparent open space especially at the top of the design. The environment was ORFS v3.0-1735-gdefc349e, and the supplied reproduction command was run-me-BoomTile-asap7-base.sh gui.
recommended_episode.observation: The issue reports 20k routing-congestion DRCs despite 0.24 placement density. The supplied placement and routing-congestion views show apparent whitespace and localized congestion.
recommended_episode.hypothesis: The thread investigated global-routing layer adjustment and congestion-iteration settings. A separate suspected global-route path looping around a macro was associated with issue #5971. The evidence does not establish that any one of these was the unique root cause.
recommended_episode.candidates_considered: Changing the routing-layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2; changing congestion iterations from 30 to 35; and separately investigating macro placement/path-loop behavior in #5971.
recommended_episode.reported_successful_configuration: eder-matheus reported that GRT could finish after changing the routing-layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 and stated that congestion iterations were changed to 35 to complete BoomTile.
recommended_episode.post_state: Global routing was reported to complete under the modified configuration. No post-fix DRC count, overflow metric, or runtime is reported. Because the two parameters changed together, the evidence does not isolate which change was necessary. No downstream detailed-routing, timing, LVS, or signoff closure is established.
limitations: No quantitative post-fix congestion/DRC result is reported.
The 0.45→0.2 and 30→35 changes were simultaneous, so causal attribution is confounded.
The macro-loop hypothesis was not resolved in this issue.
The issue is currently closed as not planned/stale and shows no linked branch or pull request, so no merged-code fix should be inferred.
recommended_episode.evidence_status: The current GitHub record confirms the issue title, failure description, 20k DRC figure, 0.24 placement density, ORFS revision, reproduction command, stale/not-planned closure, and absence of linked branches/PRs. The historical maintainer quotation should be retained only with its captured thread provenance because the currently rendered page does not expose the historical comment text.
